headline: Pavol's reading-aid pick A is live: a 'Zvýraznit rozdíly' switch, off by default and remembered per device, dotted-underlines the words the three options don't share, before answering, in practice only, never in the mock exam.

shipped.title: feat(reading-aid): Zvýraznit rozdíly — dotted underline on the words the options don't share
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-03, https://zbrojnikviz.dravec.org/okruh/zakon-o-zbranich/ at 390 px: switch aria-pressed false → true, 44 px tall, 5 dotted marks on the first question, note 'Která je správná, neříká.'

decisions.question: What counts as a differing word?
options: word alignment (LCS) against each other option
a word missing from at least one other option
decisions.default_taken: missing from at least one other option (normalised: NFC, case-insensitive, edge punctuation ignored, diacritics significant)
decisions.why: It is the definition Pavol picked ('words not shared by all three'). The review showed alignment ties marked shared words and sent 80 bank questions to 'nothing to compare'.

decisions.question: 'Practice only' — which modes?
options: every mode except the mock exam
decisions.default_taken: every mode except the mock exam (lessons, okruh practice, review, cases, bookmarks, weak spots)
decisions.why: The line Pavol drew is the exam; the real test prints three unmarked options.

decisions.question: When are the marks shown?
decisions.default_taken: before answering only; once answered, the existing near-miss marks take over
decisions.why: Option A's wording ('before you answer'), and two kinds of marks at once would compete.

decisions.question: Where is the setting kept?
decisions.why: Progress shape and Supabase stay unchanged; a display preference is per device.

decisions.question: Metric
decisions.why: Existing taxonomy; success = mock-exam accuracy on near-miss questions for aid users no worse than for non-users (SIGNATURE.md).

decisions.question: 'Both themes'
decisions.default_taken: single dark theme; marks are text-decoration in brass-400, which also survives forced-colors mode
decisions.why: The app has one theme; adding one is out of scope.

next: After two weeks: share of practice sessions with diff_aid on, and mock-exam accuracy on near-miss questions, aid users vs non-users.
